Root offline branch also persists photo files/captions in its private draft and atomically hands them to the outbox from neutral fallback. Its public static cache advances to v9 so the updated fallback is installed.

offline_classification.native_and_root_daily_log_photos: Offline draft/queue: photo bytes and captions remain user-scoped through restart; captions save before native queue/navigation. Failed storage writes retain entered values and prevent safe departure until retried. Root browser draft includes File objects and caption metadata, with atomic parent/photo/blob queuing.
offline_classification.library_download: Online-only: existing warning; already attached photos/captions remain on the form and can be queued by offline-capable surfaces.
offline_classification.pdf_export: Online-only for authenticated remote photo access/generation; existing explicit connection behavior retained. Demo uses locally retained data URLs.
offline_classification.shared_workspace: Online-only with existing loss-of-connection cover and mounted-form retention. OS termination can still lose unsaved web form input; save-before-closing notice and Field tools remain required. No claim of durable Workspace web drafts.
offline_classification.user_signout_and_upgrade: Existing account-scoped cleanup, pending-work checks and explicit discard behavior retained. No database/outbox purges or device reinstalls. Additive optional JSON fields accept old drafts/queues. Static cache v9 changes only public neutral assets, never private project records.

supported_older_mobile_builds: Previously supported clients, including recorded 300012/300013, continue sending their original payloads and using v1. Default labels also work for rows with no caption. No client UUID, idempotency key, parent identity, wire date or native storage schema is rewritten. New captions require the additive backend migration before native distribution.
permissions_idempotency_conflicts: V2 retains latest released can_edit, membership, parent author, storage owner/path/type/size and RLS checks. Same UUID/key retry returns the existing photo; changed caption under that receipt fails visibly instead of overwriting. Web receipt reconciliation also compares a supplied caption. Caption entry applies while attaching a photo; no new concurrent saved-caption editor or project/table permission widening was introduced.
